macros.token: #set $mod_name = "quantms" #set $ln_check = "" #set $ln_pattern = "" ## Experimental design: the module matches the exact name 'experimental_design.tsv', ## whose first column header is 'Fraction_Group' #if str($software_cond.exp_design) != "None": grep -qF 'Fraction_Group' '$software_cond.exp_design' || die "Module 'quantms': 'Fraction_Group' not found in the file '$software_cond.exp_design'" && ln -s '$software_cond.exp_design' '$software_dir/experimental_design.tsv' && #set $at_least_one_input=True #end if ## mzTab identification results ('*.mzTab') #set $ln_param = "mztab" @LN_GLOB@ ## Optional spectra files ('*.mzML') #set $ln_param = "mzml" @LN_GLOB@ ## Optional idXML identification files ('*.idXML') #set $ln_param = "idxml" @LN_GLOB@ ## Optional MS information ('*_ms_info.parquet') #set $ln_param = "ms_info" #set $ln_check = "suffix" #set $ln_pattern = "_ms_info.parquet" @LN_GLOB@

param.name: exp_design
param.label: Experimental design
param.help: 'experimental_design.tsv' generated by the quantms pipeline (first column 'Fraction_Group')

param.name: mztab
param.label: Identification results (mzTab)
param.help: mzTab file(s) with the identification results, e.g. 'out.mzTab'

param.name: mzml
param.label: Spectra files (mzML)
param.help: Optional mzML files, used for spectra-level quality metrics

param.name: idxml
param.label: Identification files (idXML)
param.help: Optional idXML files from the OpenMS searches

param.name: ms_info
param.label: MS information
param.help: Optional 'ms_info.parquet' with MS information from the quantms DIA analysis (filename must end in '_ms_info.parquet')
